Convert gene symbols between mouse and human

Source: R/gene_ids.R
convert_genes.Rd

Maps orthologous gene symbols between mouse (MGI) and human (HGNC) using Ensembl BioMart, or the Jackson Laboratory homology report as an alternative when the Ensembl servers are unreachable.

Usage

convert_mouse_to_human(genes, use.jax = FALSE, jax.table = NULL)

convert_human_to_mouse(genes, use.jax = FALSE, jax.table = NULL)

Arguments

genes

Character vector of gene symbols to convert.

use.jax

If TRUE, use the JAX HOM_MouseHumanSequence report instead of BioMart.

jax.table

Optional data frame holding the JAX report (as read by utils::read.delim()). If NULL the report is downloaded. Supplying it avoids the download and makes the conversion reproducible offline.

Value

With BioMart, a data frame with one row per ortholog pair (MGI.symbol, HGNC.symbol or the reverse). With use.jax = TRUE, a character vector of the converted symbols.

Details

Both directions keep one row per source symbol and per target symbol (the first match), so one-to-many orthologs are collapsed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
convert_mouse_to_human(c("Gzma", "Gzmb", "Xcl1"))
convert_human_to_mouse(c("GZMA", "GZMB", "XCL1"))
} # }
